config.ScreenBrightness
KH3 0..100 <-> Elden Ring 0..10
HOST CHOICE (IMPL_ER21, 2026-10-13; the user: "Make Config use Kingdom Heart's config menu and make the settings there actually affect Elden Ring's settings")

Elden Ring keeps its options in GameDataMan -> game_settings (SDK fromsoftware-rs 79266c9, struct GameSettings, one byte a field; hud_type at 0x9 and show_tutorials were written by earlier passes and SEEN to act in the game, IMPL_ER7 / IMPL_ER11). The game stores them in the system part of its save (never refused by save.points_only). KH3's slider is 0 - 100 with default 0 (it only brightens); Elden Ring's is 0 - 10 with default 5. Written: 5 + round(KH3 / 20) (0 -> 5, 100 -> 10); read: (game - 5) x 20, a game value under 5 reads as KH3's 0 and is LEFT ALONE while the KH3 row stays 0 (LOCAL: KH3's own curve of the slider was not read)
inferred
